label: 右向きに紹介している女の子
prompt: Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve character asset. Reference image is a visual reference for character identity, costume, pose and painterly style, NOT a background to reproduce. Create ONE isolated character cutout asset on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background (RGBA alpha); no colored paper, no white rectangle, no checkerboard printed into pixels, no scenery, no speech balloon, no calendar, no text, no frame, no ground shadow. Match the attached Japanese children's book illustration closely: warm watercolor/gouache texture, fine soft dark-brown outlines, gentle natural proportions, expressive brown eyes, delicate shading, not glossy 3D and not anime redesign. Keep one consistent character identity. Girl: chestnut bob hair, yellow star hairclip, coral cardigan with small buttons, cream shirt, teal pleated skirt. Boy: tousled short brown hair, blue zip-front hoodie over cream shirt. Final square 1536x1536 composition, character large with a small clear transparent margin around the entire subject. Never crop head, hair, fingers or required objects. Recreate ONLY the speaking girl at the LEFT foreground. Waist-up introduction pose, standing at screen left and facing SCREEN RIGHT. Her eyes and friendly open speaking mouth face RIGHT. One open palm extends toward the RIGHT side as if introducing a scene there. Keep her chestnut bob and yellow star hairclip, coral button cardigan, cream shirt and upper teal skirt. Show the full head, both visible arms and complete hand/fingers; intentional straight waist/hip crop only along lower edge of the figure. The girl alone, no bicycle, no second girl, no speech effects.
